artifact_observations.location: Edge of the bandage on the heel
artifact_observations.reasoning: The edge where the bandage meets the skin shows slight blurring and 'melting,' lacking the sharp, distinct boundary of adhesive tape lifting slightly from the skin.
Faint, nonsensical text-like artifacts or watermarks ('...oto') are visible on the floor, suggesting AI generation noise or training data leakage.
